I think you are mistaking a ubiquitous feature for a bug -- 
compiled code almost always omits the error checks implicit in
the definition of the forms.  At least one will have more of
a choice with the NIL compiler.  Of course, this isn't an
issue where the micro-code can come to the run-time rescue.
